REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, August 20, 2019 - 06:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation – Council Member Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Council Member or staff.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-j be approved.
a.

b.

SCHEDULED ITEMS
PUBLIC HEARINGS
8.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE RELATED TO LOS ANGELES COUNTY HEALTH AND SAFETY CODE AND ONSITE WASTEWATER TREATMENT SYSTEMS
Presented by Alicia Velasco, Community and Economic Development Director
ORD NO. 802 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING SECTIONS 5-1.01 (ADOPTION OF HEALTH CODE) AND 5-1.02 (COPIES FOR PUBLIC EXAMINATION) AND REPEALING SECTIONS 5-1.03 (AMENDMENTS TO HEALTH CODE) AND 5-1.04 (EMPLOYEE OUTER GARMENTS) OF TITLE V (SANITATION AND HEALTH) AND AMENDING THE TITLE OF CHAPTER 8 (SWIMMING POOLS) IN TITLE III (PUBLIC SAFETY) IN THE MUNICIPAL CODE TO ADOPT AN UPDATED VERSION OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY HEALTH AND SAFETY CODE AND FINDING THE SAME EXEMPT FROM CEQA (First Reading)
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Staff recommends that the City Council:
1)
Conduct a public hearing; have the City Attorney read by title only, an ordinance amending Title V (Public Health Code), of Chapter One (Adoption of the Health Code) of the Lomita Municipal Code to adopt by reference the updated Los Angeles County Health and Safety Code (Title 11); and
2)
Authorize a Memorandum of Understanding with the County of Los Angeles, Department of Public Health regarding onsite wastewater treatment systems and confirm the CEQA categorical exemption.
Item #8
9.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF REPEALING ORDINANCE NO. 718 (CODIFIED IN MUNICIPAL CODE TITLE IV, CHAPTER 18, SECTIONS 4-18.01 THROUGH 4-18.18)
Presented by Trevor Rusin, Assistant City Attorney
ORD NO. 803 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, REPEALING ORDINANCE NO. 718 (CODIFIED IN MUNICIPAL CODE TITLE IV, CHAPTER 18, SECTIONS 4-18.01-4.18.18) IN ITS ENTIRETY AND FINDING THE SAME EXEMPT FROM CEQA (First Reading)
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Staff recommends that the City Council:
1)
Conduct a public hearing; have the City Attorney read by title only, an ordinance repealing Ordinance No. 718 (Codified in Municipal Code Title IV, Chapter 18, Sections 4-18.01 through 4-18.18) in its entirety; and
2)
Direct staff to schedule the second reading and adoption of the ordinance for the September 3, 2019, City Council meeting.
Item #9
10.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE ADDING SECTION 8-1.07 PARKING WITHIN THE DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL ZONE AND ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION ESTABLISHING A DOWNTOWN PARKING POLICY AND ITS IMPLEMENTATION (First Reading)
Presented by Alicia Velasco, Community and Economic Development Director
ORD NO 804 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, ADDING A NEW SECTION 8-1.07 – PARKING WITHIN THE DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL ZONE TO THE LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE AND FINDING THE SAME EXEMPT FROM CEQA (First Reading)
RESO NO. 2019-21 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING A DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL ZONE PARKING POLICY
1.
Conduct a public hearing; have the City Attorney read by title only, an ordinance establishing Section 8-1.07 of the Lomita Municipal Code titled “Parking within the Downtown Commercial Zone”; and
2.
Approve a resolution establishing an on-street and public lot parking policy within the Downtown Commercial Zone; and
3.
Direct staff to implement said parking policy with the necessary signage and curb painting; and
4.
Authorize the City Manager to enter into an agreement for the design and engineering to re-stripe Narbonne Ave. from 245th St. to 243rd St., eliminating the middle turn lane and east side red curb to permit on-street parking; and
5.
Direct Staff to take the Narbonne Ave. re-striping plans to the Public Safety Traffic Commission for review and recommendation, followed by the City Council for decision.
Item #10
11.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting will be held on Tuesday, September 3, 2019, at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting at the following locations: Lomita City Hall lobby and outside bulletin board, Lomita Parks and Recreation, and uploaded to the City of Lomita website http://www.lomita.com/cityhall/city_agendas/.
Date Posted: August 16, 2019
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
